text: Has explicit 'Decision needed' section with two reasonable positions: (1) add ValidationPolicy::require_crl_sign_on_cas (default false) and restore PKITS conformance; (2) document as intentional RFC-literal divergence in INTEROP.md, keep cRLSign enforcement out of pkix-path. do-beads loop cannot pick a stance. Bead's own default recommendation is option 1 (additive, configurable, off-by-default preserves current behavior) — maintainer to ratify.
